displayDescription: Cut-paper bulb lights stepped indigo sheets, then a pinned paper arm rig fans out into a connected node system and a caption card unfolds.
styleRenderer: SVG (layered cut-paper sheets, seeded scissor-cut contours, static-layer feDropShadow contact shadows)
motionEngine: GSAP (single paused seekable timeline tweening pose values)
Procedural Paper Curl and Fold Deformation (2D hinge-fold approximation of the caption flap: cos-projected scale plus angle-dependent shading, evaluated from timeline time)
audioDescription: Silent preview: no audio track. Intended (not produced) cue sequence: soft paper slide at 0.0 s, three light paper taps as sheets drop at 0.55/0.66/0.77 s, card unfold rustle at 1.86 s.
limitations: Paper material is a procedural approximation: flat matte SVG fills, thin cream edges and drop-shadow filters; no scanned paper texture or fibre grain.
The caption fold is a 2D projected hinge (scaleY = cos angle with shading), not a 3D mesh or physical paper simulation; Three.js was not needed.
PixiJS, Paper.js and Motion were reviewed but not used; native SVG covers the flat layered cut-paper scene.

Background is a scene-dependent night-indigo stacked-sheet ramp informed by BACKGROUND_REVIEW (deepest sheet as base, quantised bands); it is not the prior cream swatch and not a copy of the source fractal.
No preview_recipes were listed in STYLE.json, so no additional recipe is demonstrated; the refresh demonstrates the stepped-sheet background construction and the jointed rig.
Silent: no soundtrack or voice was produced.
